normal_domain_basis: The 0.3 mm low-voltage control groups assume healthy 15 V bias clamp D2 and normal functional operation. The190-pair matrix is an engineering normal-operation spacing target, not proof of insulation or safe voltages under all single faults.

faults.fault: D2 open, both TL431 paths off
faults.effect: VBIAS, C8 and potentially K_CTL can charge toward VOUT via R10. Series resistance limits current, not open-circuit voltage.20 V control-domain envelope and reference/component voltage ratings are not guaranteed.
faults.status: Unqualified; no powered fault or product acceptance

faults.fault: Shared optocoupler, bias or controller path failure
faults.effect: CC and OVP share a final feedback/control path. Two TL431 references do not provide independent safety disconnection.
faults.status: Unqualified common-cause fault; no fail-safe claim

faults.fault: U1 internal power switch drain-source short
faults.effect: Nonisolated positive buck has no independent series cutoff. Rectified mains can reach output through magnetics.

fabrication_scope: A bare unpowered laboratory PCB may be fabricated to enable qualified measurements. This document neither approves a powered fault test nor declares the finished power supply safe or compliant.
before_powered_fault_tests: Responsible experienced human must define guarded setup, external protection, instrument voltage ratings, actual test limits and safe fault-insertion procedure.
